status: Exact rows read from the successful regression/benchmark job. Later UI-only refinements are not measured by these rows. This file does not independently certify the separate browser job or a Pages deployment.
methodology: CPU Stopwatch and current-thread managed allocations for a 100003-UTF-16-unit line containing two tabs. Query rows measure 10000 lookups on a preconstructed map; construction is excluded. Build rows include one map, reader and sparse arrays using a warm shared buffer pool, excluding document/snapshot creation. These are new operations without a prior-version baseline, not whole-editor speedup, cold startup, glyph/bidi/grapheme layout or physical-GPU/input-latency measurements. No independent local archive verification is claimed.
measurementReview: The earlier mixed correctness/allocation test observed 24 bytes without identifying their allocation site. The final test measures a separate non-inlined lookup method after three warmups, then requires exactly zero bytes in every one of eleven samples. The gate was not relaxed to accept an allocation allowance. It asserts steady-state behavior, not cold-start allocation.

existingCostsNotResolved.note: The complete report retains these unfavorable compiler results. Sparse-column lookup and UI improvements do not resolve all existing compiler construction/allocation/tail-latency costs.
